verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge lets agents write and update pages and notes that persist in the configured storage provider. A search capability is mentioned, so information can carry across runs. However, the evidence never says search is semantic, and it does not describe automatic capture of memories from conversations; it frames the feature as curated pages rather than conversational memory. Missing for 10: documented semantic/vector search, explicit conversation-to-memory extraction, cross-session recall examples, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add memories from conversations and retrieve them later with semantic search, so context persists across sessions

citations.quote: an agent can not only read information but update it too, allowing it to learn and self-improve over time
For updates, the agent writes the page to the scope that matches the request.
People and agents can add notes without rewriting the page.
Search only returns pages the run can read
Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider
